scope: Additional safe classroom experiment concepts only.

experiments.title: Sand and water
experiments.focus: Show that some solids make cloudy mixtures instead of clear solutions.
student_observations: The sand does not disappear completely.
Mixtures can be separated by physical methods.
experiments.teacher_note: Good for introducing mixtures versus solutions.

experiments.title: Oil and water layers
experiments.focus: Show how some liquids do not mix and instead form layers.
student_observations: Two layers appear in the model.
experiments.teacher_note: Use this to contrast with ethanol and water.

experiments.title: Filtration idea
experiments.focus: Introduce the idea that a solid can be separated from a liquid by filtration.
student_observations: The solid is held back in the filter in the model.
experiments.teacher_note: Keep the activity conceptual and classroom-level.

experiments.title: Carbon dioxide bubbles
experiments.focus: Show a gas concept and how bubbles can be used as a visible model sign.
student_observations: Bubbles are shown in the model.
The gas is invisible but can be represented by bubbles.
Gas behavior is different from liquids and solids.
experiments.teacher_note: This is a simulation concept, not a real gas-handling procedure.
